points.description: States FALSE (a user process cannot force a context switch to a chosen target process).
Justification: only the scheduler (OS/kernel) decides which process runs next; a user process can at most signal/request, with no guarantee the target is scheduled next.
points.partial_credit: Half if justification is vague, e.g. only says the user process lacks privilege or control, without naming the scheduler/OS decision.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says False and gives the central reason that the scheduler/OS, not the user process, picks the next process (signals or requests give no guarantee). Part marks: False with a vague or incomplete reason. No marks if the answer says True, or if there is no justification (a bare "False" gets 0, since the question says no justification means no marks).
